name: Forest Regalia
passive: After triggering Burning, Quicken, Aggravate, Spread, Bloom, Lunar-Bloom, Hyperbloom, or Burgeon, a Leaf of Consciousness will be created around the character for a maximum of. When picked up, the Leaf will grant the character Elemental Mastery for. Only Leaf can be generated this way every. This can still be triggered if the character is not on the field. The Leaf of Consciousness' cannot stack.
